policy: A destination is enabled only after its exact on-chain deposit call has passed a mainnet dry-run. Disabled allocation buckets remain in EmissionState and are never retroactively delivered.
releaseTrigger: Permissionless settle_and_distribute releases min(pending, batch_trades/10, 100) per tx (v16 trade gate restored in v24). distribute_released_blocks covers a prior legacy settlement.

nativePaths.routeReserve: Capped BTEN-to-SUI refill into the fixed sponsor wallet; not a generic recipient transfer.
nativePaths.traderRewards: Point-weighted automatic payments after a sealed settlement round; not a generic recipient transfer.

destinations.reason: A pool address cannot receive LP rewards. The distributor must calculate active registered positions and deposit via the chosen farm or reward module.
Requires a verified Cetus incentive/farm recipient and its deposit transaction.
No verified Bluefin on-chain recipient has been configured.
Requires a verified Turbos farm/vault recipient and its deposit transaction.
The live sponsor is already funded by the separately capped route-reserve conversion. This bucket must not double-fund it until governance selects a final policy.
No verified Haedal incentive recipient has been configured.
Aftermath is not part of BTEN. The native farm receives only newly released fixed staking allocations after the upgrade and its farm state is created.

roundingDust: At the current 50-BTEN subsidy there is no split dust. At future halvings, integer dust remains in the Haedal vault under the existing immutable-state layout until a dedicated dust migration is approved.
note: Non-staking destination configure is permanently redirected (E_REDIRECTED_BUCKET). Venue vault balances accrue via accrue_lp_program into LpProgramState.protocol_liquidity, then ops deploys OOR Cetus POL. Direct distribute_released_blocks for those buckets remains a no-op while enabled table is empty.
